# 📘 Architectural Learnings & Folder Structure Review for FrankBase.com

---

## 🎯 1. Key Learnings from EnglishVidya.com (EdTech Architecture)

EnglishVidya (`7,158 files`) is your largest and most standardized educational portal. From it, `frankbase.com` can adopt:

### A. Modular Content Engine & SSG Pipeline
- **Eleventy (11ty) Static Site Generator:** Pre-renders thousands of study notes, formula sheets, and chapter capsules into lightning-fast static HTML.
- **Markdown-Driven Content:** Store notes in structured Markdown files with YAML frontmatter (Subject, Class, Board, Difficulty, Tags) instead of hardcoding HTML.

### B. Standardized Pedagogical Framework (7-Article Methodology)
EnglishVidya standardizes every chapter into a predictable 7-step learning flow. FrankBase can apply a similar **5-to-7 Step Framework for Board & Competitive Notes**:
1. *Concept Overview & Summary* (Hindi/English)
2. *Formula / Fact Sheet & Cheat Sheet*
3. *NCERT / Textbook Solutions*
4. *Important PYQs (Previous Year Questions)*
5. *Exam-Oriented Practice MCQs*
6. *Mind Maps & PDF Download Capsule*

### C. Strict SEO & Indexation Governance
- Educational lesson drafts & WIP notes remain `noindex, follow`.
- Only verified, polished pillar pages are indexed.

### D. Automated Ops & Backup Scripts
- Root-level batch automation:
  - `01_AUTO_LOCAL_GIT_SYNC.bat`
  - `02_AUTO_GITHUB_PUSH.bat`
  - `03_CREATE_FULL_PROJECT_BACKUP_ZIP.bat`

---

## 🔐 2. Key Learnings from FrankPass.com (SaaS & Engineering Discipline)

FrankPass (`955 files`) represents zero-bloat, production-grade security and client-side architecture. From it, `frankbase.com` can adopt:

### A. PWA & Offline First Capability
- **Service Worker + Manifest:** Enable students to use tools like the *BPSC Progress Tracker* and *Formula Sheets* even without an active internet connection.
- **Client-side Storage (IndexedDB / Dexie.js):** Save student bookmarks, test scores, and custom notes locally without requiring mandatory server accounts.

### B. Security & Edge Configuration
- Cloudflare `_headers` (Content Security Policy, X-Frame-Options, HSTS).
- Cloudflare `_redirects` for clean URL routing and canonical redirects.

### C. Standardized Developer Blueprints & Audits
- Deep blueprint files: `DEVELOPER_AND_FOUNDER_BLUEPRINT.md`, `PROJECT_GUIDE.md`, `USER_GUIDE_A_TO_Z.md`.

---

## 📁 3. Review of `Website_data` Folder Structure

### 🔍 Current Structure:
```
D:\01_Websites_and_Content\MMY_Website_Project\02_frankbase.com\Website_data\
├── One time script/
├── Reaserch Discussion and Raw files/
├── multiple time used script/
└── website/
```

### ✅ Strengths:
1. Clear mental separation between reusable scripts, scratch/one-time scripts, research, and core website code.
2. Keeps experimental scripts from polluting the production code.

### ⚠️ Areas for Improvement:
1. **Folder Naming & Spaces:**
   - Folders like `One time script`, `Reaserch Discussion and Raw files`, `multiple time used script` contain spaces and typos (`Reaserch` instead of `Research`). Spaces in paths frequently break Windows batch files, PowerShell scripts, and Node.js build tools.
2. **Duplication with Root Folders:**
   - The root of `02_frankbase.com` already has:
     - `01_Study_and_Notes_Content/` (All actual notes and PWA apps)
     - `09_Raw_Materials_and_Legacy_Backups/` (Raw files & WordPress dumps)
   - If `Website_data` is also created, it creates ambiguity about where content lives vs where website code lives.

---

## 🛠️ 4. Recommended Standardized Folder Structure for FrankBase

Adopting the standard numbered tier system used across EnglishVidya and FrankPass:

```
02_frankbase.com/
├── 01_Website_Code/                <-- [From Website_data/website] (Eleventy/React/HTML app)
│   ├── src/
│   ├── public/
│   ├── functions/                  <-- Cloudflare Pages functions / API
│   └── package.json
├── 02_Study_and_Notes_Content/     <-- Master notes, NCERT, BPSC, CTET content
│   ├── 01_Competitive_Exams/
│   ├── 02_School_and_Boards_10th_12th/
│   └── 03_Ebooks_and_PDFs/
├── 03_Scripts_and_Automation/      <-- [From scripts folders]
│   ├── one_time/                   <-- Migration/scraper scripts
│   └── reusable/                   <-- Build, sync, export scripts
├── 04_Research_and_Docs/           <-- [From Reaserch Discussion...] Blueprints, prompts, guides
├── 05_Designs_and_UI/              <-- UI tokens, CSS stylesheets, banners, mockups
├── 09_Raw_Materials_and_Backups/   <-- Raw archives & legacy snapshots
├── AGENT_PROMPT.md
├── project_map.json
└── map.json
```

# 🏛️ FrankBase.com — Complete System Blueprint & Phased Execution Plan > **Document Version:** 1.0.0 > **Target Project:** `PRJ-02-FRANKBASE` (`https://frankbase.com`) > **Master Architecture:** Git-Driven JAMstack + Cloudflare Edge + Google Auth + Normalized Security Questions --- ## 🎯 1. User Capabilities: Without Login vs With Login ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ FRANKBASE.COM USERS │ ├─────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────┤ │ WITHOUT LOGIN (Guest) │ WITH LOGIN (Member) │ ├─────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤ │ • 100% Free Reading of all │ • Everything in Guest PLUS: │ │ Notes, NCERT, BPSC/CTET │ • Bookmark Notes & Chapters │ │ • View Formula Sheets │ • Cloud Progress Sync │ │ • Practice Free Quizzes │ • Detailed Quiz Analytics │ │ • Search Entire Knowledge │ • Comments & Discussions │ │ • Offline Reading (PWA) │ • Custom Notes & Highlights │ │ • Use Public Calculators │ • Member Download Vault │ └─────────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### A. Without Login (100% Friction-Free Guest Experience) * **Open Knowledge Access:** Sabhi study notes, NCERT solutions, BPSC syllabus breakdown, CTET pedagogy, formula sheets bilkul open aur free rahenge. * **Interactive Tool Usage:** Free quizzes, calculators, aur basic converters bina login ke chalenge. * **Zero-Friction Browsing:** Koi forced popup ya paywall nahi hoga. * **Local Offline Cache (PWA):** Service worker guest user ke browser me bhi recently viewed notes ko offline padhne ke liye save karega. ### B. With Login (Progressive Value-Add Account) * **Bookmarks & Favorites:** Important notes aur chapters ko 1-click me save karke personal dashboard me access karna. * **Progress Tracking:** BPSC Syllabus tracker, CTET scorecards, aur completed chapters ka sync across devices. * **Quiz History & Detailed Analytics:** Mock test ke scorecard, weak areas report, aur time-per-question analysis. * **Comments & Community:** Chapters aur notes ke niche doubt puchna ya discussion me part lena. * **Exclusive Resources:** Printable curated PDF cheat-sheets aur premium digital packs download access. --- ## 🚀 2. Article Publishing Workflow: Direct Terminal & GitHub **Haan! 100% Terminal aur GitHub se article publish hoga.** Ye fastest, safest, aur cleanest approach hai. ```mermaid graph LR A["✍️ Write Markdown Note
(Local VS Code/Terminal)"] --> B["📁 Save in Content Repo
(e.g., content/bpsc/gs.md)"] B --> C["⚡ git commit & git push
(or one-click .bat script)"] C --> D["☁️ Cloudflare Pages CI/CD
(Automated Build in 15-30s)"] D --> E["🌍 Live on frankbase.com
(Global Edge CDN)"] ``` ### Kyo ye WordPress/CMS se behtar hai? 1. **Zero Database Attacks:** Koi SQL injection ya WordPress plugin hack hone ka khatra nahi. 2. **Lightning Fast (<100ms load time):** Static pre-rendered pages Cloudflare Edge par cached rehte hain. 3. **Full Version History (Git):** Har article ka complete edit history, author rollback, aur diff track hota hai. 4. **Offline Authoring:** Aap bina internet ke bhi terminal me markdown notes likh sakte hain, jab net aaye tab 1 command se live! --- ## 👥 3. Roles & Permissions (RBAC Matrix: Owner vs Admin vs User) | Function / Capability | Regular User | Admin (Moderator) | Owner (Master Manikant) | |---|:---:|:---:|:---:| | **Read Notes & Use Public Tools** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Save Bookmarks & Track Progress** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Post Comments / Ask Doubts** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Approve / Delete / Moderate Comments** | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Review User Reports & Spam Flags** | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Access Admin Dashboard & Engagement Stats** | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Publish / Edit Content via Git** | ❌ | ❌ (Unless given Git access) | ✅ | | **Manage Cloudflare DNS / Workers / Secrets** | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | **Promote / Demote Admins & Block Users** | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | **Access Supabase / D1 Database Direct SQL** | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | **Google Search Console & SEO Governance** | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | **Financial / Digital Store / Ad Placements** | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | --- ## 🔐 4. Authentication & Normalized Security Questions System ### A. Signup Strategy * **Initial Onboarding:** **Google OAuth 2.0 (Sign in with Google)** only. * **Why Google-first?** - Fake accounts aur spam bots zero ho jaate hain. - Verified email automatically milta hai. - 1-click zero friction login. ### B. Post-Signup Optional Password & Security Questions Setup Signup ke baad user chahe to optional custom password set kar sakta hai (alternate login ke liye), sath me **Security Questions Recovery System**. ```mermaid graph TD A["User Google Signup"] --> B["Profile Dashboard"] B --> C{"Set Alternate Password?"} C -->|Yes| D["Select 5 Security Questions
from 15 Preset Pool"] D --> E["Set Answers + Choose Reset Threshold
(e.g., 3 out of 5 or 5 out of 5)"] E --> F["Normalized SHA-256 Hash Stored in DB
(Never Plaintext)"] ``` ### C. Normalization Logic (Case & Space Insensitive) Aapka requirement: **`"Ram is" == "ram Is" == "ramis" == " RAM IS "`** #### The Algorithm: ```javascript // Step 1: Input Normalization Function function normalizeAnswer(rawAnswer) { if (!rawAnswer) return ""; // 1. Lowercase all characters // 2. Remove all whitespaces, tabs, newlines, and punctuation return rawAnswer.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s\-_.,'"]/g, ""); } // Example Proof: // normalizeAnswer("Ram is") => "ramis" // normalizeAnswer("ram Is") => "ramis" // normalizeAnswer("ramis") => "ramis" // normalizeAnswer(" RAM IS ") => "ramis" // Step 2: Cryptographic Hashing with Salt async function hashNormalizedAnswer(normalizedAnswer, userSalt) { const salted = normalizedAnswer + userSalt; const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(salted)); return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); } ``` ### D. 15 Preset Security Questions Pool: 1. Aapke pehle primary school ka naam kya tha? 2. Aapka bachpan ka favourite dost kaun tha? 3. Aapka janam kis shahar/gaaon me hua tha? 4. Aapka pehla pet (paltoo janwar) ka naam kya tha? 5. Aapki manpasand kitab ya novel kaunsi hai? 6. Aapke sabse priya teacher ka naam kya tha? 7. Aapke pehle mobile phone ka brand kaunsa tha? 8. Aapke pita ji ka janam sthan (birthplace) kya hai? 9. Aapke bachpan ka nickname kya tha? 10. Aapka all-time favourite subject kaunsa hai? 11. Aapke nanihal (maternal hometown) ka naam kya hai? 12. Aapki pehli cycle kis brand ya rang ki thi? 13. Aapka favourite khana/dish kaunsa hai? 14. Aapke pehle coaching institute ka naam kya tha? 15. Aapka favourite historical hero ya personality kaun hai? ### E. Dynamic Reset Threshold: * Setup karte waqt user select karta hai ki password reset ke waqt kitne sawaal sahi hone chahiye: - Option A: **3 out of 5** (Balanced) - Option B: **4 out of 5** (High Security) - Option C: **5 out of 5** (Maximum Security) --- ## 📅 5. Phased Development Roadmap (Aapka Proposal 100% Sahi Hai!) Aapka sochna bilkul accurate aur industry-standard hai: **Pehle mandatory lightweight core pages live karke Google Search Console me submit karna chahiye**, taaki domain indexing aur trust timer shuru ho sake. ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 4-PHASE DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP │ ├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤ │ PHASE 1: Foundation & GSC Verification (IMMEDIATE) │ │ • High-Speed Modern SSG Framework (Tailwind + Eleventy/HTML5) │ │ • Core Trust Pages: Home, About Us, Contact Us, Privacy Policy, │ │ Terms & Conditions, Disclaimer, Legal, Agreement │ │ • sitemap.xml, robots.txt, Google Search Console Verification Meta │ │ • Central Lead Webhook Integration (mmcentral.pages.dev) │ │ │ │ PHASE 2: Content Pipeline & Git Publishing │ │ • Markdown Note Templates & Frontmatter Schema │ │ • Categorization: Bihar Board (10th/12th), BPSC, SSC, CTET │ │ • Automated GitHub Push & Cloudflare Pages CI/CD │ │ • Strict `noindex, follow` on WIP educational capsules │ │ │ │ PHASE 3: Authentication & Security Engine │ │ • Google Sign-In Integration │ │ • Security Questions Setup & Normalized Hash Engine │ │ • User Dashboard: Bookmarks, Notes, Progress Tracker │ │ │ │ PHASE 4: Interactive Tools & Subdomain Integration │ │ • In-browser Quiz & Scorecard Engine │ │ • PWA Service Worker for Offline Study │ │ • Subdomain Cross-Links (Speed, Typing, PDF, Tools, Store) │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` --- ## 🔍 6. Phase 1 Immediate Action Items (Core Launch) 1. **Clean Root Folder Alignment:** - Standardize `01_Website_Code`, `02_Study_and_Notes_Content`, `03_Scripts_and_Automation`, `04_Research_and_Docs`. 2. **Build Core Pages:** - `index.html` (Modern FrankBase Education Gateway) - `about-us.html` (Mission, Founder details, Trust profile) - `contact.html` (Contact form connected to `https://mmcentral.pages.dev/api/submit-lead`) - `privacy-policy.html` (GDPR/DPDP compliant) - `terms-and-conditions.html` - `disclaimer.html` (Educational fair-use disclaimer) - `legal.html` & `agreement.html` 3. **SEO & Search Console Readiness:** - `robots.txt` - `sitemap.xml` - Canonical tags & Google Site Verification meta tag. 4. **Deploy & Submit:** - Push to GitHub $\rightarrow$ Deploy on Cloudflare Pages $\rightarrow$ Submit URL in Google Search Console.

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: January 1, 2026 • Last Updated: August 18, 2026

1. Our Privacy Commitment

At FrankBase (`https://frankbase.com`), accessible globally and operated by Master Manikant Yadav (Legal Name: Manikant Kumar), Supaul, Bihar, we believe privacy is a fundamental right. We are committed to transparency in how we handle user data across all our educational modules.

2. Information We Collect

A. Public Users (No Account Required): All educational content, notes, formula sheets, NCERT guides, and calculators are accessible without any registration. We do NOT track individual browsing history, sell user data, or inject third-party spyware.

B. Contact Inquiries & Feedback: If you voluntarily reach out via our contact form or WhatsApp, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and message solely to respond to your academic or support query.

C. Google OAuth (When Enabled): When signing in via Google Single Sign-On for bookmarking or community features, we only request your verified email address and basic profile display name.

3. How We Use Information

  • To serve educational materials and interactive test results quickly and securely.
  • To answer inquiries and resolve study note corrections submitted by students.
  • To protect against malicious DDoS attacks and automated abuse via Cloudflare Edge security.

4. Data Storage & Security Questions Normalization

For security questions and password recovery features, all answers are sanitized through a strict normalization algorithm (lowercase and whitespace stripping) and cryptographically hashed using salted SHA-256 before storage. We NEVER store plaintext security answers in our databases.

5. Third-Party Services & Infrastructure

We utilize enterprise-grade infrastructure partners including Cloudflare Pages/DNS (for edge caching and SSL encryption). These services process anonymized network telemetry to ensure website uptime and speed.

6. Contact For Privacy Questions

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, you can reach out directly to:

  • Privacy Officer: Master Manikant Yadav
  • Official Email: support@frankbase.com
  • Postal Address: Supaul, Bihar, India — PIN: 852131

# ⚖️ Consolidating All Legal Pages into `legal.html`: Deep Analysis & Implementation

> **Topic:** Should all legal documents (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Disclaimer, User Agreement) be merged into a single `legal.html` with expandable/collapsible accordion cards?  
> **Verdict:** **YES (Recommended via Hybrid Hash-Routing Architecture)**  

---

## 🎯 1. Direct Recommendation: YES, BUT HYBRID

**Yes, consolidating all legal policies into a single interactive `legal.html` with expandable/shrinkable cards is an excellent, modern, and user-friendly approach.**

However, to guarantee 100% compliance with **Google AdSense**, **Google Search Console**, and **Payment Gateways** (which sometimes check for dedicated privacy URLs), we implement a **Hybrid URL Hash-Routing Model**:
- **Single Source of Truth:** `legal.html` holds all policies inside interactive accordion cards.
- **Deep Anchor Linking:** Direct URLs (`legal.html#privacy`, `legal.html#terms`, `legal.html#disclaimer`, `legal.html#agreement`) automatically expand that specific card on page load.
- **Clean 301 Redirects:** Legacy URLs (`/privacy-policy.html` $\rightarrow$ `/legal.html#privacy`) smoothly redirect.

---

## 📊 2. Detailed Pros & Cons Breakdown

| Category | 🟢 PROS (Single `legal.html` with Accordion) | 🔴 CONS (Separate 5-6 Files) |
|---|---|---|
| **User Experience (UX)** | Clean, modern, non-overwhelming. Users click to expand only what they want to read. | A wall of 10,000+ words across multiple slow page reloads. |
| **Code Maintenance** | **1 single file to maintain.** Any header, footer, or branding update happens in 1 place. | Must manually update 5-6 different HTML files every time design changes. |
| **Footer Cleanliness** | Footer needs only 1 or 2 clean links (`Legal Hub`, `Privacy`). | Footer gets cluttered with 5-6 long policy links. |
| **Edge Cache & Speed** | Single cached static file on Cloudflare Edge (<50ms). | Multiple static pages consuming more build/cache memory. |
| **AdSense & Legal Compliance** | 100% compliant when supported with `#hash` deep-links. | Requires managing multiple individual URLs. |

---

## 🛠️ 3. How the Shrink/Expand Accordion Card System Works

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                  LEGAL HUB (legal.html)                      │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  [+] 1. Privacy Policy & Data Protection            [EXPAND] │
│      (Shows details on zero tracking, Google Auth, etc.)     │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  [+] 2. Terms & Conditions of Use                   [EXPAND] │
│      (Shows permitted fair use, copyright guidelines)        │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  [+] 3. Educational & Government Non-Affiliation    [EXPAND] │
│      (Shows BSEB, BPSC, CTET, NCERT non-affiliation)         │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  [+] 4. Student & Member User Agreement             [EXPAND] │
│      (Shows academic integrity, discussion rules)            │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  [+] 5. Ownership, DMCA & Legal Contact             [EXPAND] │
│      (Shows Master Manikant Yadav credentials & email)       │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Key Technical Features:
1. **Interactive Toggle:** Click on any card header to expand or collapse smoothly.
2. **Auto-Expand from URL Hash:** If someone visits `https://frankbase.com/legal.html#privacy`, JavaScript detects `#privacy`, scrolls smoothly, and opens the Privacy card automatically with an accent highlight!
3. **Accessibility:** Proper `aria-expanded="true/false"` tags for screen readers and SEO crawlers.
4. **"Expand All / Collapse All" Utility Button:** Allows users/auditors to read all policies at once in 1 click.

---

## 🚀 4. Summary Matrix

| Approach | Recommended? | Key Benefit |
|---|:---:|---|
| **Multiple 5-6 Disjointed Files** | ❌ No | High maintenance overhead, cluttered footer. |
| **Single Static Wall of Text** | ❌ No | Poor UX, overwhelming to mobile readers. |
| **Unified `legal.html` with Accordion Cards + Deep Hash Links** | ✅ **YES (100% Best Practice)** | Best UX, 1 single file to maintain, instant deep links, and full Google/AdSense compliance. |

```

## 🎯 1. Strategic Analysis: Homepage Ecosystem Showcase (YES / NO / WHY)

```
                       ┌─────────────────────────┐

                       └────────────┬────────────┘

### Why this is essential for `frankbase.com`:
1. **Hub-and-Spoke Traffic Flywheel:** `frankbase.com` attracts high-volume organic search traffic from students looking for BSEB/BPSC/CTET notes. Featuring clean ecosystem cards immediately routes those visitors into your typing tutor, PDF converters, and English learning platforms.
2. **SEO PageRank Flow:** Clear, semantic HTML internal links from your main root domain pass domain authority to your specialized subdomains (`tools.`, `speed.`, `typing.`, `pdf.`, etc.).
3. **Ecosystem Brand Recall:** Users realize FrankBase is not just a static blog, but a complete digital ecosystem built to empower their entire academic and career journey.

---

## ⚖️ 2. New Legal Clauses Added to `legal.html`

### A. Right to Modify & Policy Amendments ("May Change At Any Time")
* **Binding Clause:** FrankBase reserves the right to modify, amend, update, or replace any policy, term, or disclaimer at any time without prior individual notice.
* **Effective Date Tracking:** The updated date at the top of the page signifies the latest active legal agreement. Continued usage after changes implies full acceptance.

### B. Advertising, Google AdSense & Affiliate Disclosures
* **Google AdSense Compliance:** Explicit declaration that third-party ad networks (like Google AdSense) may use cookies (e.g. DART cookies) to serve non-intrusive, relevant advertisements based on visits.
* **Affiliate Disclosure:** Full transparency that FrankBase may participate in affiliate programs (such as Amazon Associates or educational tool recommendations). When users click affiliate links and make a purchase, FrankBase may earn a small commission at **zero additional cost** to the user.
* **Editorial Independence Guarantee:** Affiliate partnerships never compromise our educational recommendations or formula accuracy.

Effective Date: January 1, 2026 • DPDP Act 2023 & GDPR Compliant

A. Zero-Tracking Public Access

FrankBase (`https://frankbase.com`) par sabhi educational notes, formula sheets, NCERT summaries aur study materials 100% open aur bina kisi forced login ke available hain. Hum kisi bhi public visitor ka personal browsing data track ya commercial brokers ko sell nahi karte.

B. Google OAuth 2.0 Privacy

Agar aap bookmarks save karne ya community discussions ke liye Google Sign-In ka upyog karte hain, toh hum sirf aapka verified email address aur public display name fetch karte hain. Hum aapke contacts ya personal drive data ka access kabhi nahi maangte.

C. Security Questions Hashing Guarantee

Password reset aur account recovery ke liye set kiye gaye security questions ko hum strict normalization (case & space insensitive) ke baad salted SHA-256 cryptographic hash me convert karke store karte hain. Plaintext answers database me kabhi save nahi hote.

D. Cloudflare Infrastructure

Website security aur fast loading ke liye Cloudflare CDN infrastructure ka upyog kiya jata hai jo anonymous network security telemetry process karta hai.

Last Updated: August 18, 2026

A. Permitted Educational Fair Use

FrankBase par uplabdh sabhi content students, shikshakon aur competitive exam candidates ke vyaktigat adhyayan (personal study) ke liye hai.

  • Aap revision ke liye notes aur formula sheets padh sakte hain aur personal print le sakte hain.
  • Humaare content, formula sheets ya question banks ko bulk scrape karke kisi doosri commercial website par bechna ya republish karna kanoonan sakht mana hai.

B. Intellectual Property

Master Manikant Yadav dwara taiyar kiye gaye pedagogical frameworks, simplified notes, stylesheets aur software code copyright kanoon ke tahat sanrakshit hain.

C. Community Conduct

Comment sections ya discussion forums me kisi bhi tarah ki gaali-galoj, spam, ya abusive bhasha ka upyog karne par account turant block kar diya jayega.

Legal Protection & Scope of Liability

A. Provision "As Is" and "As Available"

FrankBase par uplabdh sabhi notes, formulas, PYQs, aur educational tools "jaisa hai" (As-Is) aur "uplabdhata ke aadhar par" (As-Available) pradan kiye jaate hain. Hum kisi bhi prakar ki explicit ya implicit warranty nahi dete ki material 100% truti-mukt (error-free) hoga ya website kabhi down nahi hogi.

B. No Liability for Examination Outcomes

FrankBase ke material ka prayog karne se kisi specific marks, rank, merit list, ya sarkari naukri (BPSC / STET / SSC) me selection ki koi legal guarantee nahi hoti. Examination ka result poori tarah student ki apni mehnat, samajh aur aayog ke evaluation par nirbhar karta hai. FrankBase ya iske founder kisi bhi academic failure ya selection na hone ke liye legal roop se utardayi (liable) nahi honge.

C. Cap on Total Monetary Liability

Kanoon dwara anumat adhiktam seema tak, FrankBase aur Master Manikant Yadav ki kisi bhi claim, loss, ya damage ke liye kul dayitva (aggregate liability) ₹0 (free users ke liye) ya user dwara pichle 30 dino me chukayi gayi rashi (paid assets ke liye) se adhik nahi hogi.

D. External Links & Third-Party Services

Hamari website par sarkari aayogon (BPSC, BSEB, CBSE) ya external reference links ho sakte hain. Hum kisi bhi teesre paksh (third-party) ki website ke content, privacy policy ya terms ke liye zimmedar nahi hain.

Monetization & Transparency Policy

A. Google AdSense & Third-Party Advertising

FrankBase par future me free servers aur open educational infrastructure ko maintain karne ke liye Google AdSense ya anya vetted ad networks ke dwara advertisements display kiye ja sakte hain.

  • Google AdSense teesre paksh ke cookies (jaise DART cookies) ka upyog kar sakta hai taaki users ko unki ruchi ke anurup non-intrusive ads dikhaye ja sakein.
  • Users chahein toh Google Ads Settings par jakar personalized advertising ko opt-out kar sakte hain.

B. Affiliate Marketing & Commission Disclosure

FrankBase par kabhi-kabhi recommended books (jaise NCERT reference guides, standard BPSC preparation books), digital study tools ya hardware ke affiliate links diye ja sakte hain.

  • Agar aap humare diye gaye affiliate link par click karke koi purchase karte hain, toh hume bina kisi extra cost ke ek chhota sa affiliate commission mil sakta hai.
  • Editorial Independence: Kisi bhi affiliate partnership ka asar humari educational recommendations ya factual study material ki accuracy par kabhi nahi padta. Hum sirf wahi kitabein aur tools recommend karte hain jo students ke liye genuinely labhkari hon.

Continuous Governance & Binding Terms

A. Right to Update Without Prior Notice

FrankBase reserves the unilateral right to amend, update, modify, or replace any part of this Legal Hub, Privacy Policy, Terms, or Disclaimers at any time, with or without prior individual notice.

B. How You Stay Informed

Regulatory Fair-Use Notice

A. Independent Educational Portal

FrankBase ek swatantra (independent) educational portal hai. Hum kisi bhi sarkari aayog ya board se officially affiliated ya endorsed nahi hain, jisme shamil hain:

  • Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB / Bihar Board)

  • Offline Notes Cache (PWA): Internet bina bhi offline notes padhne ke liye temporary browser cache.

Digital Goods & Instant Delivery Guidelines

Website par maujood 95%+ notes aur mock tests 100% free hain. Optional premium printable packs instant digital delivery goods hote hain.

Safe Learning Environment for School Students

Hum 18 varsh se kam aayu ke bachhon ka koi sensitive data collect nahi karte. FrankBase par koi adult content ya unsafe promotions display nahi hote.

IT Act 2000 & DPDP Act 2023 Statutory Compliance

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="hi" data-theme="light">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  
  <title>{{ title | default("FrankBase — India's Open Knowledge & Study Hub") }}</title>
  <meta name="description" content="{{ description | default("FrankBase is an open, high-speed educational knowledge base by Master Manikant Yadav. Free Bihar Board notes, BPSC TRE, CTET, and NCERT formula sheets.") }}" />
  <link rel="canonical" href="https://frankbase.com{{ page.url }}" />

  <!-- Open Graph -->
  <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
  <meta property="og:url" content="https://frankbase.com{{ page.url }}" />
  <meta property="og:title" content="{{ title | default("FrankBase — Open Knowledge & Study Hub") }}" />
  <meta property="og:description" content="{{ description | default("Free educational notes for Bihar Board, BPSC, CTET, and formula sheets.") }}" />
  <meta property="og:image" content="https://frankbase.com/assets/og-image.jpg" />

  <!-- Twitter Meta -->
  <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
  <meta name="twitter:title" content="{{ title | default("FrankBase — Open Knowledge & Study Hub") }}" />
  <meta name="twitter:description" content="{{ description | default("100% Free & Open study material.") }}" />

  <!-- CRITICAL ANTI-FOUC DAY/NIGHT THEME SCRIPT -->
  <script>
    (function() {
      try {
        var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('frankbase_theme') || 'light';
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', savedTheme);
      } catch (e) {}
    })();
  </script>

  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/style.css" />
  <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="any" />

  <!-- Schema.org EducationalOrganization -->
  <script type="application/ld+json">
  {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "EducationalOrganization",
    "name": "FrankBase",
    "url": "https://frankbase.com",
    "founder": {
      "@type": "Person",
      "name": "Master Manikant Yadav",
      "jobTitle": "Educator & Systems Architect",
      "url": "https://mastermanikant.com"
    },
    "description": "Comprehensive Hindi-Medium & Bihar Board (10th/12th, BPSC TRE, STET, CTET, NCERT) open knowledge base."
  }
  </script>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- UNIVERSAL MODULAR HEADER (No Hardcoding) -->
  {% include "partials/header.njk" %}

  <main id="main-content">
    {{ content | safe }}
  </main>

  <!-- UNIVERSAL MODULAR FOOTER (No Hardcoding) -->
  {% include "partials/footer.njk" %}

  <script src="/js/app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

Founder & Ecosystem Profile

The Story Behind FrankBase

Supaul, Bihar se lekar ek global open educational knowledge network tak ka safar.

Master Manikant Yadav (Manikant Kumar)

Founder & Lead Architect • Supaul, Bihar

Mera safar ek classroom teacher ke roop mein shuru hua. Maine dekha ki hazaron mehnati students sirf isliye piche reh jaate hain kyunki unke paas structured, high-quality, aur bina hidden charges wali Hindi-medium study material nahi hoti. FrankBase usi problem ka solution hai.

Board exams (BSEB 10th/12th) aur competitive exams (BPSC TRE, STET, CTET) ke liye hum complex books ko concise formula sheets aur chapter capsules me convert karte hain taaki kam se kam samay me maximum retention ho sake.

Technology + Pedagogy Architecture

Hum traditional bulky websites nahi banate jo ads se bhari ho aur slow load karein. FrankBase ko modern JAMstack aur Cloudflare Edge technology par banaya gaya hai.

Ye mobile-friendly hai, offline PWA capability ke sath chalta hai, aur village internet connection par bhi sub-second speed se open hota hai.

--- layout: layouts/base.njk title: "Legal & Compliance Hub — FrankBase (Privacy, Terms, Ads Disclosure & Policies)" description: "Official Legal and Compliance Hub for FrankBase. Consolidated Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Limited Liability, AdSense & Affiliate Disclosures, and Policy Amendment Terms." permalink: "/legal/" ---
Unified Compliance & Statutory Center

Legal & Compliance Hub

FrankBase ke sabhi regulatory policies, limited liability terms, AdSense/Affiliate disclosures, disclaimers aur statutory governance ek jagah.

Click on any card to view policy details or use deep-link anchors.

Effective Date: January 1, 2026 • DPDP Act 2023 & GDPR Compliant

A. Zero-Tracking Public Access

FrankBase (`https://frankbase.com`) par sabhi educational notes, formula sheets, NCERT summaries aur study materials 100% open aur bina kisi forced login ke available hain. Hum kisi bhi public visitor ka personal browsing data track ya commercial brokers ko sell nahi karte.

B. Google OAuth 2.0 Privacy

Agar aap bookmarks save karne ya community discussions ke liye Google Sign-In ka upyog karte hain, toh hum sirf aapka verified email address aur public display name fetch karte hain. Hum aapke contacts ya personal drive data ka access kabhi nahi maangte.

C. Security Questions Hashing Guarantee

Password reset aur account recovery ke liye set kiye gaye security questions ko hum strict normalization (case & space insensitive) ke baad salted SHA-256 cryptographic hash me convert karke store karte hain. Plaintext answers database me kabhi save nahi hote.

D. Cloudflare Infrastructure

Website security aur fast loading ke liye Cloudflare CDN infrastructure ka upyog kiya jata hai jo anonymous network security telemetry process karta hai.

Last Updated: August 18, 2026

A. Permitted Educational Fair Use

FrankBase par uplabdh sabhi content students, shikshakon aur competitive exam candidates ke vyaktigat adhyayan (personal study) ke liye hai.

  • Aap revision ke liye notes aur formula sheets padh sakte hain aur personal print le sakte hain.
  • Humaare content, formula sheets ya question banks ko bulk scrape karke kisi doosri commercial website par bechna ya republish karna kanoonan sakht mana hai.

B. Intellectual Property

Master Manikant Yadav dwara taiyar kiye gaye pedagogical frameworks, simplified notes, stylesheets aur software code copyright kanoon ke tahat sanrakshit hain.

C. Community Conduct

Comment sections ya discussion forums me kisi bhi tarah ki gaali-galoj, spam, ya abusive bhasha ka upyog karne par account turant block kar diya jayega.

Legal Protection & Scope of Liability

A. Provision "As Is" and "As Available"

FrankBase par uplabdh sabhi notes, formulas, PYQs, aur educational tools "jaisa hai" (As-Is) aur "uplabdhata ke aadhar par" (As-Available) pradan kiye jaate hain. Hum kisi bhi prakar ki explicit ya implicit warranty nahi dete ki material 100% truti-mukt (error-free) hoga ya website kabhi down nahi hogi.

B. No Liability for Examination Outcomes

FrankBase ke material ka prayog karne se kisi specific marks, rank, merit list, ya sarkari naukri (BPSC / STET / SSC) me selection ki koi legal guarantee nahi hoti. Examination ka result poori tarah student ki apni mehnat, samajh aur aayog ke evaluation par nirbhar karta hai. FrankBase ya iske founder kisi bhi academic failure ya selection na hone ke liye legal roop se utardayi (liable) nahi honge.

C. Cap on Total Monetary Liability

Kanoon dwara anumat adhiktam seema tak, FrankBase aur Master Manikant Yadav ki kisi bhi claim, loss, ya damage ke liye kul dayitva (aggregate liability) ₹0 (free users ke liye) ya user dwara pichle 30 dino me chukayi gayi rashi (paid assets ke liye) se adhik nahi hogi.

D. External Links & Third-Party Services

Hamari website par sarkari aayogon (BPSC, BSEB, CBSE) ya external reference links ho sakte hain. Hum kisi bhi teesre paksh (third-party) ki website ke content, privacy policy ya terms ke liye zimmedar nahi hain.

Monetization & Transparency Policy

A. Google AdSense & Third-Party Advertising

FrankBase par future me free servers aur open educational infrastructure ko maintain karne ke liye Google AdSense ya anya vetted ad networks ke dwara advertisements display kiye ja sakte hain.

  • Google AdSense teesre paksh ke cookies (jaise DART cookies) ka upyog kar sakta hai taaki users ko unki ruchi ke anurup non-intrusive ads dikhaye ja sakein.
  • Users chahein toh Google Ads Settings par jakar personalized advertising ko opt-out kar sakte hain.

B. Affiliate Marketing & Commission Disclosure

FrankBase par kabhi-kabhi recommended books (jaise NCERT reference guides, standard BPSC preparation books), digital study tools ya hardware ke affiliate links diye ja sakte hain.

  • Agar aap humare diye gaye affiliate link par click karke koi purchase karte hain, toh hume bina kisi extra cost ke ek chhota sa affiliate commission mil sakta hai.
  • Editorial Independence: Kisi bhi affiliate partnership ka asar humari educational recommendations ya factual study material ki accuracy par kabhi nahi padta. Hum sirf wahi kitabein aur tools recommend karte hain jo students ke liye genuinely labhkari hon.

Continuous Governance & Binding Terms

A. Right to Update Without Prior Notice

FrankBase reserves the unilateral right to amend, update, modify, or replace any part of this Legal Hub, Privacy Policy, Terms, or Disclaimers at any time, with or without prior individual notice.

B. How You Stay Informed

Jab bhi koi sanshodhan (amendment) hoga, is page ke top par "Last Updated" date ko update kar diya jayega. Website ka nirantar prayog (continued use) ye darshata hai ki aap naye sanshodhit niyamon ko poori tarah swikar karte hain.

Regulatory Fair-Use Notice

A. Independent Educational Portal

FrankBase ek swatantra (independent) educational portal hai. Hum kisi bhi sarkari aayog ya board se officially affiliated ya endorsed nahi hain, jisme shamil hain:

  • Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB / Bihar Board)
  • Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC)
  • Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
  • Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET)

Zero-Tracking Privacy Guarantee

A. Functional LocalStorage Usage Only

  • frankbase_theme: User ka light ya dark mode preference save karne ke liye.
  • Offline Notes Cache (PWA): Internet bina bhi offline notes padhne ke liye temporary browser cache.

Digital Goods & Instant Delivery Guidelines

Website par maujood 95%+ notes aur mock tests 100% free hain. Optional premium printable packs instant digital delivery goods hote hain.

Safe Learning Environment for School Students

Hum 18 varsh se kam aayu ke bachhon ka koi sensitive data collect nahi karte. FrankBase par koi adult content ya unsafe promotions display nahi hote.

IT Act 2000 & DPDP Act 2023 Statutory Compliance

  • Grievance Officer: Master Manikant Yadav (Manikant Kumar)
  • Designation: Founder & Data Privacy Controller
  • Official Email: legal@frankbase.com
  • Postal Address: Supaul, Bihar, India — PIN: 852131
  • Response Timeline: Acknowledgement within 24 hours and resolution within statutory 15 days.

args.CodeContent:
# ⚡ FrankBase.com — Eleventy (11ty) Modular Architecture Report

> **Project:** `02_frankbase.com` (`https://frankbase.com`)  
> **Architecture Pattern:** 100% Eleventy (11ty) SSG matching `englishvidya.com`  
> **Template Engine:** Nunjucks (`.njk`) with Zero Hardcoded Components  
> **Theme Engine:** Anti-FOUC Persistent Day/Night Mode (Light/Dark)  
> **Remote Repository:** `https://github.com/Mastermanikant/frankbase.git` (`main` branch)  

---

## 🏛️ 1. Architecture: WordPress-like Modular Templating (Zero Hardcoding)

Just like WordPress uses `header.php` and `footer.php`, FrankBase now uses **Eleventy Nunjucks Partials**:

```
01_Website_Code/
├── eleventy.config.js          <-- 11ty Build & Passthrough Engine
├── package.json                <-- NPM scripts (npm run build, npm run dev)
├── public/                     <-- Static Assets (Passthrough to _site/)
│   ├── css/style.css           <-- Design system with CSS variables
│   ├── js/app.js               <-- Theme switcher & Lead Ingestion Form
│   ├── robots.txt              <-- Search Console Governance
│   ├── _headers                <-- Cloudflare Edge Security & Cache
│   └── _redirects              <-- 301 Canonical & Legal Anchor Redirects
└── src/
    ├── _includes/
    │   ├── layouts/
    │   │   └── base.njk        <-- Master HTML Shell (Head, Anti-FOUC, Schema)
    │   └── partials/
    │       ├── header.njk      <-- Fixed Universal Header & Active Nav
    │       └── footer.njk      <-- Universal Footer & Legal Links
    ├── index.njk               <-- Homepage Content
    ├── about-us.njk            <-- Founder Profile & Story
    ├── contact.njk             <-- Inquiries & Central Lead Webhook
    ├── legal.njk               <-- 10-Card Accordion Compliance Hub
    └── sitemap.njk             <-- Dynamic XML Sitemap Generator
```

---

## 🌓 2. Day/Night Theme Persistence (Anti-FOUC Guarantee)

### The Problem in Traditional Web Apps:
When a user selects **Dark Mode** and refreshes or clicks another page, there is often a white flicker (*Flash of Unstyled Content - FOUC*) before the JavaScript loads.

### The FrankBase Solution:
We placed an immediate, non-blocking theme execution script at the very top of `<head>` inside [`src/_includes/layouts/base.njk`](file:///D:/01_Websites_and_Content/MMY_Website_Project/02_frankbase.com/01_Website_Code/src/_includes/layouts/base.njk):

```html
<script>
  (function() {
    try {
      var savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('frankbase_theme') || 'light';
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', savedTheme);
    } catch (e) {}
  })();
</script>
```

### Benefits:
1. **0ms Theme Switch:** The page renders immediately in the user's chosen theme (Light or Dark) without any flicker.
2. **Global Sync:** Switching theme on the homepage keeps the same theme active across About, Contact, and Legal pages.
3. **Pure CSS Variables:** Colors adapt dynamically via `data-theme="dark"` and `data-theme="light"`.

---

## ⚡ 3. Build & Deployment Execution

```bash
# Build Command
npx @11ty/eleventy

# Result
[11ty] Writing ./_site/sitemap.xml from ./src/sitemap.njk
[11ty] Writing ./_site/about-us/index.html from ./src/about-us.njk
[11ty] Writing ./_site/contact/index.html from ./src/contact.njk
[11ty] Writing ./_site/index.html from ./src/index.njk
[11ty] Writing ./_site/legal/index.html from ./src/legal.njk
[11ty] Copied 5 Wrote 5 files in 0.32 seconds (v3.1.6)
```

---

## 🚀 4. Cloudflare Pages Build Settings

When linking `Mastermanikant/frankbase` in Cloudflare Pages:
* **Framework Preset:** `None` (or `Eleventy`)
* **Build command:** `npm run build` (or `npx @11ty/eleventy`)
* **Build output directory:** `_site`

# 🌐 FrankBase.com — Live Deployment & Search Console Submission Report

> **Live Production URL:** `https://frankbase.pages.dev/`  
> **Custom Domain:** `https://frankbase.com/`  
> **Cloudflare Pages Project:** `frankbase` (Account ID: `2168b749e9320ae01c8ec00b48c4c64f`)  
> **GitHub Repository:** `https://github.com/Mastermanikant/frankbase.git` (`main` branch)  
> **Sitemap URL:** `https://frankbase.com/sitemap.xml`  

---

## ⚡ 1. Live Cloudflare Pages Deployment

Using Wrangler CLI with authenticated OAuth token (`mastermanikant.in@gmail.com`), the static build output (`_site`) was built and deployed:

```bash
# Build & Deploy Sequence
1. npx @11ty/eleventy
2. wrangler pages project create frankbase --production-branch=main
3. wrangler pages deploy _site --project-name=frankbase

# Result
✨ Success! Uploaded files to Cloudflare Pages Edge CDN.
🌎 Live URL: https://frankbase.pages.dev/
```

### Verified Live Endpoints:
- **Homepage:** `https://frankbase.pages.dev/` (Status: 200 OK)
- **About Founder:** `https://frankbase.pages.dev/about-us/` (Status: 200 OK)
- **Contact:** `https://frankbase.pages.dev/contact/` (Status: 200 OK)
- **Legal & Compliance Hub:** `https://frankbase.pages.dev/legal/` (Status: 200 OK)
- **XML Sitemap:** `https://frankbase.pages.dev/sitemap.xml` (Status: 200 OK)

---

## 🔍 2. Search Console & Webmaster Tools Submission

The `/browser` automation agent has been launched to interact with:

### A. Google Search Console (`search.google.com/search-console`)
1. **Property Target:** `https://frankbase.com`
2. **Verification Method:** DNS Record (Cloudflare automatic verification) or HTML meta tag.
3. **Sitemap Submission:** `https://frankbase.com/sitemap.xml`

### B. Bing Webmaster Tools (`bing.com/webmasters`)
1. **Import from Google Search Console** (1-click automatic sync) or direct URL submission.
2. **Sitemap Indexing:** `https://frankbase.com/sitemap.xml`

### C. Cloudflare Custom Domain Binding
- In Cloudflare Dashboard $\rightarrow$ **Workers & Pages** $\rightarrow$ `frankbase` $\rightarrow$ **Custom Domains** $\rightarrow$ Add `frankbase.com` and `www.frankbase.com`.
- Once custom domain CNAME points to `frankbase.pages.dev`, `frankbase.com` will immediately replace the Hostinger parking page.

---

## 📋 3. Infrastructure Summary

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Ecosystem Role** | Flagship Open Knowledge Base (Bihar Board, BPSC, CTET) |
| **SSG Framework** | Eleventy 3.0.0 (11ty) with Nunjucks partials |
| **Theme Engine** | Zero-FOUC LocalStorage Light/Dark switcher |
| **Hosting** | Cloudflare Pages (Global Anycast Edge Network) |
| **Lead Routing** | `https://mmcentral.pages.dev/api/submit-lead` |
| **Sitemap Lastmod** | Dynamic `YYYY-MM-DD` ISO generation |

# 📜 Bing Webmaster Tools — SOAP & POX API Deprecation Explained

> **URL Ref:** `https://www.bing.com/webmasters/help/soap-pox-api-deprecation-s0appox01`  
> **Topic:** Legacy API Deprecation & Modern Indexing Standards  

---

## 🔍 1. What Does "SOAP / POX API Deprecation" Mean?

### A. What were SOAP and POX APIs?
- **SOAP** (*Simple Object Access Protocol*) and **POX** (*Plain Old XML*) were old, heavy XML-based communication protocols used by Bing Webmaster Tools in the 2010s to let software automatically submit URLs and retrieve crawl stats.

### B. What Does "Deprecation" Mean?
- **Deprecation** means Microsoft has officially **retired and turned off** these old XML endpoints.
- Any legacy software or outdated SEO plugin that attempts to send requests in the old XML/SOAP format will receive an error.

---

## ⚡ 2. What Replaced Them? (Modern Standards)

Microsoft Bing Webmaster Tools transitioned to modern, faster, and lighter standards:

1. **Modern JSON REST API:**
   - Fast, lightweight REST endpoints using standard JSON formats.
2. **IndexNow Protocol (`IndexNow.org`):**
   - An open, real-time indexing protocol co-created by Microsoft Bing and Yandex. Whenever you publish an article or note, a simple HTTP POST request notifies Bing to crawl it in seconds.
3. **Bing Webmaster Web UI & Standard Sitemaps:**
   - Standard XML sitemaps (`https://frankbase.com/sitemap.xml`) submitted via the web dashboard or robots.txt.

---

## 🛡️ 3. Does It Impact FrankBase.com?

### 👉 **NO Impact on FrankBase! (100% Safe)**
- **Standard Sitemaps Work Normally:** Our XML sitemap (`/sitemap.xml`) uses standard W3C XML schema, which is fully supported by both Google and Bing.
- **Modern Infrastructure:** FrankBase is built on modern Jamstack / Cloudflare Edge architecture and does not rely on deprecated 2010-era SOAP endpoints.

# 🛠️ FrankBase.com — Hostinger Parking Screen Issue & 2-Minute Fix Guide

> **Issue Shown in Screenshot:** `frankbase.com` displays *"Registered at Hostinger / Parked Domain"*  
> **Root Cause:** In Cloudflare DNS, the domain `frankbase.com` has an old Hostinger A-Record pointing to Hostinger's default parked server IP instead of `frankbase.pages.dev`.  

---

## 🎯 1. Why Is This Happening?

1. **Domain Registrar:** The domain `frankbase.com` was purchased on **Hostinger**.
2. **Cloudflare Nameservers:** The domain's nameservers are pointed to Cloudflare (`dora.ns.cloudflare.com` & `terin.ns.cloudflare.com`).
3. **The DNS Conflict:**
   - In your **Cloudflare DNS Records**, the root domain (`@` or `frankbase.com`) is currently set to an **A Record** pointing to Hostinger's IP address (`185.x.x.x` or default).
   - Therefore, visitors are seeing Hostinger's default parked page.

---

## ⚡ 2. The 2-Minute Fix in Cloudflare Dashboard

To instantly route `frankbase.com` to our new live website:

### Step 1: Open Cloudflare DNS
1. Go to [Cloudflare Dashboard](https://dash.cloudflare.com).
2. Click on the domain **`frankbase.com`** $\rightarrow$ Click on **DNS** (left menu) $\rightarrow$ **Records**.

### Step 2: Delete Old Hostinger A Record
- Look for any **Type: A** record with Name: `@` or `frankbase.com` pointing to Hostinger's IP.
- Click **Edit** $\rightarrow$ **Delete** that A record.

### Step 3: Add CNAME Record pointing to Cloudflare Pages
- Click **Add Record**:
  - **Type:** `CNAME`
  - **Name:** `@` (or `frankbase.com`)
  - **Target:** `frankbase.pages.dev`
  - **Proxy status:** 🟧 **Proxied** (Orange Cloud ON)
  - Click **Save**.

### Step 4: For `www.frankbase.com` (Subdomain)
- Click **Add Record**:
  - **Type:** `CNAME`
  - **Name:** `www`
  - **Target:** `frankbase.pages.dev`
  - **Proxy status:** 🟧 **Proxied** (Orange Cloud ON)
  - Click **Save**.

---

## 🌐 3. Current Live Verification

While DNS propagates, the website is already **100% LIVE and functional** on Cloudflare Pages:
👉 **[https://frankbase.pages.dev/](https://frankbase.pages.dev/)**

# 🤖 How Antigravity AI Works — Behind the Scenes Architecture

> **Agent:** Antigravity (Advanced Agentic AI System)  
> **Environment:** Windows / Local Machine paired with Developer Tools  

---

## ⚡ 1. How I Am Able to Build & Deploy Your Website Automatically

Main ek simple chat bot nahi hoon, balki ek **Autonomous Full-Stack AI Engineer** hoon jise aapke system par direct developer tools execute karne ki power di gayi hai:

### A. Terminal & Local Execution Power (`run_command`)
- Main aapke computer ke terminal (PowerShell) par commands run kar sakta hoon.
- **Eleventy (`11ty`):** Main source code files (`.njk`, `.css`, `.js`) likh kar `npx @11ty/eleventy` execute karta hoon, jisse 0.3 second me static HTML pages generate ho jaate hain.

### B. Git & GitHub Remote Automation
- Jab bhi code likha jaata hai, main background me:
  `git add .` $\rightarrow$ `git commit -m "..."` $\rightarrow$ `git push origin main`  
  chala kar aapke GitHub repository (`Mastermanikant/frankbase`) ko 100% sync kar deta hoon.

### C. Cloudflare REST APIs & Wrangler CLI
- Main aapke machine me pehle se logged-in **Cloudflare OAuth tokens** ko read karke Cloudflare ke official REST API ko programmatic request bhejta hoon:
  - Naya Pages project create kiya: `frankbase`
  - Website build files upload kiye: `_site/` $\rightarrow$ Cloudflare Anycast Edge CDN
  - Custom Domains attach kiye: `frankbase.com` & `www.frankbase.com`

### D. Browser Automation Subagents (`/browser`)
- Main background me ek **Browser Subagent** launch kar sakta hoon jo **Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)** ke through directly aapke open Chrome tabs me interact karke buttons click aur forms fill karta hai.

---

## 🔒 2. Jahan User Ki Zaroorat Hoti Hai (Security Boundary)

Jab koi action aapke Chrome browser ke private session ya direct security prompt se juda hota hai (jaise browser popup me *"Allow Remote Debugging"* ya Cloudflare me master security confirmation), toh Chrome security guard lock kar deta hai.

Isliye main:
1. Maximum automated kaam (code generation, git push, build, API calls, record deletion) **khud kar deta hoon**.
2. Jahan 1 click par browser lock lagta hai, wahan aapko **direct deep link aur 2-click shortcut** de deta hoon taaki aapka time 100% bache!

# 🛡️ D: Drive Autonomous Mapping, Provenance, Git & Execution Rules

## 1. Zero-Prompt Autonomous Ledger Execution
Whenever any task creates, modifies, moves, consolidates, or deletes files/folders across D: Drive:
- **Mandatory Final Step:** Before sending the final response to the user, the agent MUST automatically record the action in `00_MM_Central_Command/disc_d_map.json` and append a micro-entry to `00_MM_Central_Command/operation_ledger.jsonl`.
- **Local Map Update:** If changes occurred within a specific project folder (e.g. `01_mastermanikant.com`, `02_frankbase.com`, `06_englishvidya.com`), update that project's local `project_map.json`.

## 2. Token-Optimized Micro-Append Invariant
- Never re-parse or rewrite large multi-megabyte JSON trees for minor single-file changes.
- Append a compact JSON object (5-10 lines) containing:
  `{ "op_id", "timestamp", "action", "summary", "from", "to", "files_count", "vault_backup", "rollback_cmd" }`
- Keeps token consumption ultra-low (~50-80 tokens per operation).

## 3. Safe Deletion & Rollback Guarantee
- Prior to any destructive deletion or major consolidation, freeze a copy in:
  `D:\05_Personal_Vault_and_Backups\_rollback_vault\<TIMESTAMP>_<OP_ID>\`
- Support 1-command rollback by referencing the `op_id`.

## 4. 3-Tier Hierarchy Standard
- **Tier 1 (Global):** `D:\01_Websites_and_Content\MMY_Website_Project\00_MM_Central_Command\disc_d_map.json`
- **Tier 2 (Pillar):** `D:\<Pillar_Folder>\category_map.json`
- **Tier 3 (Project):** `D:\...\<project_folder>\project_map.json`

## 5. Strict SEO Indexation & Noindex Governance Invariant
- **Default Content State:** All educational content, grammar lessons, chapter articles, quizzes, dictionary pages, and drafts MUST ALWAYS REMAIN `noindex, follow` by default.
- **Core Identity Exception:** Only Core Brand Trust/Legal pages (`/`, `/about-us/`, `/about-us-hindi/`, `/founder-mastermanikant/`, `/founder-mastermanikant-hindi/`, `/legal/`, `/legal-hindi/`, `/contact/`, `/agreement/`) are permitted to be indexed.
- **Strict Prohibition on Unprompted Indexing:** The AI Agent is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from changing any page from `noindex` to `index` without explicit, direct user approval in the prompt.
- **Advisory Obligation:** When an educational module/chapter is 100% polished, tested, and verified, the agent may proactively remind the user and propose indexing, but MUST WAIT for explicit user confirmation before applying the change.

## 6. Git & GitHub Remote Synchronization Invariant
- **Mandatory Git Commits:** Whenever code, templates, styles, or configuration files are modified within any project repository on D: Drive, meaningful git commits must be made with descriptive conventional messages.
- **Remote Push Guarantee:** The AI Agent MUST automatically push commits to remote GitHub (`git push origin <branch>`) to guarantee that the online GitHub repository is 100% synchronized with the local workspace state before wrapping up tasks.

## 7. Mandatory Pre-Action Local Git Checkpoint & Sync Invariant
- **Pre-Execution Checkpoint:** Before modifying, refactoring, deleting, or creating any files in any project repository on D: Drive, the AI Agent MUST FIRST run `git status`.
- **Local Git Synchronization:** If a remote git origin exists, verify and pull latest updates (`git pull --rebase origin <branch>`) to ensure local workspace is 100% up to date before making changes.
- **Clean State Freezing:** If there are unstaged or uncommitted changes, or before beginning a new phase/refactor, the agent MUST immediately create a local checkpoint commit:
  `git add . ; git commit -m "checkpoint: pre-<task-description> state"`
- **Zero-Data-Loss Rollback Guarantee:** This ensures an instant 1-command rollback point (`git reset --hard HEAD` / `git checkout .`) is guaranteed prior to any exploratory or structural changes across all project folders.

## 8. End-to-End Autonomous Execution Invariant
- **Proactive Multi-Tool Resolution:** Whenever an action can be performed through ANY tool or technique available to the agent (PowerShell scripts, CLI commands, Cloudflare/GitHub REST APIs, OAuth tokens, browser subagents, headless sessions, or build compilers), the AI Agent MUST autonomously execute and complete the task end-to-end.
- **Zero Unnecessary User Offloading:** The AI Agent is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN from asking the user to manually perform steps or clicks that the agent can execute via available tools (e.g. DNS configuration, API bindings, code builds, git push).
- **Strict Exception:** The agent may only prompt the user when strictly blocked by an external user-exclusive barrier (e.g. 2FA SMS OTP, hardware security key, or non-automatable CAPTCHA).

## 🚀 1. PageSpeed Insights Core Web Vitals Optimization

We executed the following micro-optimizations across [`src/`](file:///D:/01_Websites_and_Content/MMY_Website_Project/02_frankbase.com/01_Website_Code/src):

### A. Eliminated Render-Blocking Google Fonts (FCP & LCP Boost)
- **Before:** Fonts were loaded via `@import url(...)` inside `style.css`, causing a severe render-blocking network waterfall.
- **After:**
  - Removed `@import` from `style.css`.
  - Added high-speed `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` and `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>`.
  - Loaded font stylesheet asynchronously with `media="print" onload="this.media='all'"` and fallback `<noscript>`.

### B. Fixed Image Layout Shift & Faster LCP (CLS = 0)
- Explicitly specified `width="180" height="180"` and `decoding="async"` with `loading="lazy"` on founder avatars in `index.njk` and `about-us.njk`.
- Prevents any Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) on mobile screens.

### C. Cloudflare Edge Micro-Caching
- Retained immutable 1-year asset caching (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`) for `/css/*` and `/js/*` in `public/_headers`.

47: 48:

The Founder’s Story

49:

Hello! I’m Master Manikant, and I created EnglishVidya to help students who struggle with English — just like I once did.

50: 51:
52: “मैंने अंग्रेजी सीखने और समझने में बहुत मुश्किलों का सामना किया, और मैं नहीं चाहता कि किसी और को भी ये कठिनाइयाँ झेलनी पड़े।”
53: (I faced many difficulties in learning and understanding English, and I don't want anyone else to go through those same hardships.) 54:
55: 56:

My educational background includes a B.Sc. in Mathematics, a B.Ed. degree, and STET qualification. Over the years, I have taught students ranging from Classes 6 to 10 in coaching institutes, and Class 12 students through home tuition.

57: 58:

The Incident That Changed Everything

59:

The story of EnglishVidya didn't start in a boardroom; it started in a classroom.

60:

One day, while teaching a Class 10 student, I asked him to translate a very simple Hindi sentence into English. Despite studying English for years in school, reading grammar books, and attending coaching classes, he went completely blank. He couldn't do it.

61:

That moment hit me hard. Millions of Hindi-medium students study English merely to "pass the exam." They memorize rules, cram definitions, and yet, they live in constant fear of speaking or writing practical English. I decided it was time to build a platform that solves this exact problem so nobody has to go through the same confusion and frustration.

62: 63:

Rebuilding from Zero

64:

The journey of building EnglishVidya was not easy. I purchased the domain and hosting on 18 March 2025. For months, I poured my heart into it, and by January 2026, the website was running smoothly with great content.

65:

However, due to financial struggles, the hosting expired on 18 March 2026. I couldn't renew it. I managed to save all the website's data and hard work on my old laptop, hoping to upload it later when things got better.

66:

But fate had other plans. In June 2026, my old laptop completely broke down and could not be repaired. Years of hard work, drafted articles, and data were trapped inside a dead machine. I had nothing left.

67:

It was devastating. But a mission driven by true purpose doesn't die. Instead of giving up, I chose to start from absolute zero. I am rebuilding EnglishVidya from the ground up—this time, not just as a blog, but as an indestructible, 100% comprehensive learning ecosystem.

Built by Master Manikant Yadav to provide 100% free, structured education for Hindi-medium candidates." permalink: /about-us/ lang: en hreflangEn: /about-us/ hreflangHi: /about-us-hindi/ schemaJson: | { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "AboutPage", "name": "About FrankBase", "description": "Discover FrankBase's mission, core study tracks, and pedagogy. Home › About FrankBase
English हिंदी
Open Education Platform

About FrankBase

Democratizing Quality Education for Bihar Board & Competitive Exam Aspirants

Welcome to FrankBase — India's open educational knowledge base and rapid revision portal, founded by educator and systems architect Master Manikant Yadav in Supaul, Bihar. FrankBase was engineered to solve a fundamental crisis in Indian school and competitive education: the lack of high-yield, structured, and 100% unpaywalled study materials for Hindi-medium and bilingual students.

"True education must be open, unencumbered by artificial paywalls, and built with extreme clarity. If a student has the hunger to learn, lack of costly coaching materials should never stand in their way."
— Master Manikant Yadav, Founder of FrankBase

🎯 Our Core Mission & Vision

  • Open Knowledge Guarantee: Every single chapter capsule, formula cheat sheet, and pedagogy guide on FrankBase is permanently free. No hidden paywalls, no forced subscriptions, and no compulsory credit card traps.
  • Bilingual Pedagogy: Complex scientific concepts, mathematical theorems, and child pedagogy frameworks are explained in intuitive Hinglish/Hindi so students retain foundational clarity without linguistic friction.
  • High-Speed Edge Architecture: Built on modern static edge technology to load in under 500 milliseconds, even on slow 3G/4G mobile networks across rural Bihar and India.

📚 What We Teach & Study Tracks

🔬

BSEB Class 12th (Inter Science & Arts)

NCERT-aligned chapter notes for Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Hindi 100M, and English 100M.

📐

BSEB Class 10th (Matriculation)

Comprehensive Science capsules, step-by-step Maths theorems, Social Science, Hindi, and Sanskrit guides.

🏛️

BPSC TRE & Bihar STET

Targeted General Studies, Bihar Special History/Geography, and Teaching Aptitude modules for educator exams.

👶

CTET Pedagogy (Paper 1 & 2)

Concept breakdowns of Piaget, Vygotsky, Kohlberg, RTE 2009, and NEP 2020 frameworks.

⚡ What Makes FrankBase Unique?

  1. Formula-First Design: 1-page condensed revision sheets for last-minute exam recall.
  2. Zero Clutter UI: Strict WordPress-like clean typography with instant Day/Night mode and zero layout shifts.
  3. Ecosystem Power: Seamlessly connected to specialized sister tools like SpeedPulse, Typing Tutor, and PDF Exam Converter.

👨‍🏫 Meet Our Founder

FrankBase is personally curated and maintained by Master Manikant Yadav (Manikant Kumar), a qualified educator with STET 2025 (107 Marks), B.Ed, and B.Sc Mathematics credentials.

Read Master Manikant's Full Biography →

English हिंदी
ओपन एजुकेशन पोर्टल

फ्रैंकबेस (FrankBase) के बारे में

हिंदी माध्यम एवं बिहार के विद्यार्थियों के लिए सरल, स्पष्ट और पूर्णतः निशुल्क शिक्षा

फ्रैंकबेस (FrankBase) में आपका स्वागत है। यह भारत का एक खुला, आधुनिक और 100% निशुल्क शैक्षणिक ज्ञान कोष है, जिसकी स्थापना सुपौल (बिहार) के शिक्षक एवं सिस्टम्स आर्किटेक्ट मास्टर मणिकांत यादव द्वारा की गई है। फ्रैंकबेस की शुरुआत एक ठोस संकल्प के साथ हुई: हर जरूरतमंद छात्र तक गुणवत्तापूर्ण, सुनियोजित और बिना किसी शुल्क वाली अध्ययन सामग्री पहुंचाना।

“सच्ची शिक्षा वह है जो किसी महंगे सब्सक्रिप्शन या पेवॉल की मोहताज न हो। यदि किसी छात्र में पढ़ने की लगन है, तो आर्थिक तंगी उसके सपनों के बीच कभी नहीं आनी चाहिए।”
— मास्टर मणिकांत यादव (संस्थापक, फ्रैंकबेस)

🎯 हमारा मुख्य उद्देश्य एवं विज़न

  • शून्य पेवॉल नीति (100% Free): फ्रैंकबेस पर उपलब्ध हर अध्याय के नोट्स, फॉर्मूला शीट्स और प्रैक्टिस सेट्स पूरी तरह निशुल्क हैं। कोई छिपा हुआ शुल्क या अनिवार्य रजिस्ट्रेशन नहीं है।
  • द्विभाषी एवं सरल शिक्षण शैली (Bilingual Pedagogy): विज्ञान, गणित और बाल विकास (CDP) के कठिन से कठिन नियमों को आसान हिंदी और व्यावहारिक उदाहरणों के साथ समझाया गया है।
  • अल्ट्रा-फास्ट लोडिंग स्पीड: यह वेबसाइट आधुनिक क्लाउड तकनीक पर बनी है, जिससे ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों के 3G/4G नेटवर्क पर भी यह 0.5 सेकंड से कम समय में खुलती है।

📚 प्रमुख अध्ययन श्रेणियां (Study Tracks)

🔬

बिहार बोर्ड 12वीं (इंटर साइंस एवं आर्ट्स)

भौतिक विज्ञान, रसायन विज्ञान, गणित, जीवविज्ञान, 100 अंक हिंदी और 100 अंक अंग्रेजी के अध्यायवार नोट्स।

📐

बिहार बोर्ड 10वीं (मैट्रिक परीक्षा)

एनसीईआरटी आधारित विज्ञान कैप्सूल, गणित के प्रमेय, सामाजिक विज्ञान, हिंदी और संस्कृत मार्गदर्शिका।

🏛️

BPSC शिक्षक भर्ती (TRE) एवं STET

सामान्य अध्ययन, बिहार विशेष इतिहास/भूगोल और शिक्षण अभिरुचि (Teaching Aptitude) के हाई-यील्ड नोट्स।

👶

CTET बाल विकास एवं शिक्षाशास्त्र (CDP)

पियाजे, वाइगोत्स्की, कोहलबर्ग के सिद्धांत, RTE 2009 और NEP 2020 की बिंदुवार व्याख्या।

⚡ फ्रैंकबेस दूसरों से अलग कैसे है?

  1. फॉर्मूला-फर्स्ट रिवीजन शीट्स: परीक्षा के अंतिम दिनों में तुरंत दोहराने के लिए 1-पेज संक्षिप्त फॉर्मूला कैप्सूल।
  2. क्लीन एवं विकर्षण-मुक्त डिज़ाइन: दिन/रात (Dark/Light) मोड और बिना किसी भटकाव वाली सरल बनावट।
  3. मल्टी-टूल इकोसिस्टम: SpeedPulse, Typing Tutor और PDF Exam Converter जैसे उपयोगी टूल्स से जुड़ाव।

👨‍🏫 हमारे संस्थापक से मिलें

फ्रैंकबेस का संचालन व्यक्तिगत रूप से मास्टर मणिकांत यादव (मणिकांत कुमार) द्वारा किया जाता है, जो बिहार STET 2025 (107 अंक), B.Ed और B.Sc गणित की योग्यताओं से संपन्न शिक्षक हैं।

मास्टर मणिकांत की पूरी जीवन यात्रा पढ़ें →

Home › About › Founder Master Manikant
English हिंदी

Master Manikant Yadav (Manikant Kumar)

Founder, Lead Educator & Systems Architect • Supaul, Bihar

Dedicated mathematics & pedagogy educator, Bihar STET 2025 qualified, and advocate for 100% open, paywall-free digital education in India.

🎓 B.Sc Maths (Hons) — BNMU 📜 B.Ed — Jiwaji University 🏆 Bihar STET 2025 (107 Marks) 💻 ADCA Certified
The Founder's Journey

From Grassroots Classrooms to Open Digital Knowledge

Hello! I am Master Manikant Yadav (officially Manikant Kumar), an educator, writer, and web systems architect based in Supaul, Bihar.

My journey in education began at the foundational level — teaching Mathematics, Science, and English to students of Classes 6 to 10 in offline coaching institutes, and mentoring Class 12 candidates through intensive home tutoring.

“I experienced firsthand how hard it is for a Hindi-medium student to find clear, concise, and dependable study material. My mission with FrankBase is to ensure no student ever faces those difficulties alone.”
— Master Manikant Yadav

🎓 Academic Qualifications & Background

  • B.Sc in Mathematics (Honours): Bhupendra Narayan Mandal University (BNMU), Madhepura, Bihar. Deep foundations in analytical problem solving, calculus, and mathematical modeling.
  • Bachelor of Education (B.Ed): Jiwaji University, Gwalior. Specialized training in child pedagogy, instructional design, and educational psychology.
  • Bihar STET 2025 Qualified: Cleared with a distinguished score of 107 Marks.
  • Advanced Diploma in Computer Applications (ADCA): Hands-on expertise in software systems, modern web engineering, and edge cloud architecture.

💡 The Classroom Moment That Started It All

The vision for FrankBase and its sister platforms did not emerge in an air-conditioned corporate office; it was born directly on the blackboard of a humble classroom in Bihar.

While mentoring matriculation students, I noticed a heartbreaking pattern: students possessed immense hard work and dedication, yet their performance faltered because standard textbooks were bloated with repetitive jargon, and online coaching apps locked essential revision notes behind expensive paywalls.

I decided that education should not be held hostage by paywalls. I began writing 1-page condensed formulas, intuitive concept capsules, and bilingual explanations designed to give students absolute mastery in minimal study time. FrankBase is the realization of that dream.

🌱 Rebuilding from Scratch with Unyielding Resilience

Building this platform tested every ounce of my endurance. In early 2026, due to sudden hardware failures and hosting expirations, years of drafted notes and data were locked away on a dead machine.

Instead of walking away, I resolved to rebuild the entire digital ecosystem from absolute zero — faster, more resilient, and permanently stored on modern edge architecture. FrankBase stands today as a testament to the fact that when a mission is grounded in true student service, no obstacle is permanent.

📬 Connect with Master Manikant

Have suggestions, study questions, or want to collaborate? I welcome direct feedback from learners, parents, and fellow educators.

  • Executive Desk Email: connect@mastermanikant.com
  • Headquarters: Supaul, Bihar, India — PIN: 852131
  • Personal Brand Flagship: mastermanikant.com

Follow Official Channels (@frankbase):

English हिंदी

मास्टर मणिकांत यादव (मणिकांत कुमार)

संस्थापक, मुख्य शिक्षक एवं सिस्टम्स आर्किटेक्ट • सुपौल, बिहार

गणित एवं शिक्षणशास्त्र के समर्पित शिक्षक, बिहार STET 2025 उत्तीर्ण, और भारत में 100% खुली, निशुल्क डिजिटल शिक्षा के प्रबल समर्थक।

🎓 B.Sc गणित (ऑनर्स) — BNMU 📜 B.Ed — जीवाजी यूनिवर्सिटी 🏆 बिहार STET 2025 (107 अंक) 💻 ADCA प्रमाणित
संस्थापक की जीवन यात्रा

जमीनी क्लासरूम से डिजिटल ज्ञान क्रांति तक

नमस्कार! मैं मास्टर मणिकांत यादव (आधिकारिक नाम: मणिकांत कुमार) हूँ — सुपौल (बिहार) से एक शिक्षक, लेखक एवं वेब सिस्टम्स आर्किटेक्ट।

मेरी शिक्षा यात्रा क्लासरूम के ब्लैकबोर्ड से शुरू हुई। मैंने कोचिंग संस्थानों में कक्षा 6 से 10 के विद्यार्थियों को गणित, विज्ञान और अंग्रेजी पढ़ाया और कक्षा 12 के छात्रों को व्यक्तिगत मार्गदर्शन दिया।

“मैंने स्वयं देखा है कि एक हिंदी माध्यम के छात्र के लिए स्पष्ट, बिंदुवार और बिना किसी भटकाव वाली अध्ययन सामग्री मिलना कितना कठिन होता है। फ्रैंकबेस का उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि किसी भी छात्र को इन कठिनाइयों से अकेले न जूझना पड़े।”
— मास्टर मणिकांत यादव

🎓 शैक्षणिक योग्यताएं एवं पृष्ठभूमि

  • B.Sc गणित प्रतिष्ठा (Mathematics Honours): भूपेंद्र नारायण मंडल विश्वविद्यालय (BNMU), मधेपुरा, बिहार। विश्लेषणात्मक चिंतन, कैलकुलस और गणितीय सिद्धांतों में गहरी पकड़।
  • बैचलर ऑफ एजुकेशन (B.Ed): जीवाजी विश्वविद्यालय, ग्वालियर। बाल मनोविज्ञान, आधुनिक शिक्षण विधियों (Pedagogy) और पाठ्यक्रम निर्माण का विधिवत प्रशिक्षण।
  • बिहार STET 2025 उत्तीर्ण: राज्य शिक्षक पात्रता परीक्षा में 107 अंकों के साथ उत्कृष्ट सफलता।
  • एडवांस्ड डिप्लोमा इन कंप्यूटर एप्लीकेशन्स (ADCA): आधुनिक वेब सिस्टम्स, डेटाबेस और क्लाउड आर्किटेक्चर का व्यावहारिक ज्ञान।

💡 वह क्लासरूम का अनुभव जिसने सब बदल दिया

फ्रैंकबेस का विचार किसी कॉर्पोरेट ऑफिस में नहीं, बल्कि बिहार के एक साधारण क्लासरूम में पैदा हुआ।

पढ़ाते समय मैंने महसूस किया कि छात्रों में प्रतिभा और मेहनत की कोई कमी नहीं है, लेकिन भारी-भरकम किताबों की जटिल भाषा और ऑनलाइन ऐप्स के महंगे पेवॉल (सब्सक्रिप्शन) के कारण वे बुनियादी कॉन्सेप्ट्स में उलझ जाते हैं।

उसी दिन मैंने तय किया कि शिक्षा को पेवॉल का बंधक नहीं बनने दिया जाएगा। मैंने 1-पेज फॉर्मूला कैप्सूल, द्विभाषी आसान परिभाषाएं और परीक्षा-केंद्रित नोट्स तैयार करना शुरू किया ताकि कम समय में छात्र सर्वोत्तम परिणाम पा सकें।

🌱 शून्य से पुनः निर्माण और अटूट संकल्प

इस डिजिटल मंच को बनाने का सफर आसान नहीं रहा। वर्ष 2026 की शुरुआत में तकनीकी खराबी और पुराने कंप्यूटर के पूरी तरह बंद हो जाने के कारण वर्षों की मेहनत और ड्राफ्ट नोट्स एक बंद मशीन में फंस गए।

लेकिन जब उद्देश्य सच्चा हो, तो रुकावटें हौसला नहीं तोड़ सकतीं। मैंने हार मानने के बजाय शून्य से पूरी वेबसाइट को दोबारा कोड किया — इस बार और भी तेज़, आधुनिक और सुरक्षित रूप से। फ्रैंकबेस इसी अटूट संकल्प का परिणाम है।

📬 मास्टर मणिकांत से संपर्क करें

यदि आपके पास कोई सुझाव है, अध्ययन से संबंधित प्रश्न है, या आप मार्गदर्शन चाहते हैं, तो आप सीधे संपर्क कर सकते हैं:

  • ऑफिशियल ईमेल: connect@mastermanikant.com
  • मुख्यालय: सुपौल, बिहार, भारत — पिन: 852131
  • पर्सनल वेबसाइट: mastermanikant.com

# Rule: Founder Privacy, Name Invariant & Strict Email Obfuscation

1. **Private Personal Gmail Protection:**
   - The founder's private personal email `mastermanikant.in@gmail.com` is STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL and MUST NEVER be exposed in any frontend HTML, markdown templates, UI cards, or public code.
   - It is solely used as a backend destination inbox for Cloudflare Email Routing.

2. **Mandatory Official Domain Emails:**
   - **Founder Desk / Executive:** `connect@mastermanikant.com`
   - **Support Inquiries:** `support@frankbase.com` / `support@englishvidya.com` / `support@frankpass.com`
   - **Legal & Statutory Grievance:** `legal@frankbase.com`

3. **Standard Founder Name Invariant:**
   - **In English:** Always use **Master Manikant Yadav** (NEVER include "Manikant Kumar" or "(Manikant Kumar)").
   - **In Hindi:** Always write **मास्टर मणिकान्त यादव** with आधा 'न' (`कान्त`), NEVER with anusvara (`कांत`).

# 🚀 FrankBase.com SEO & Search Console Live Indexing Report

> **Target Domain:** `https://frankbase.com/`  
> **Search Console Property:** `sc-domain:frankbase.com`  
> **Live Test Result:** ✅ **"URL is available to Google" (Page can be indexed)**

> **Latest Git Commit:** [`6166708`](https://github.com/Mastermanikant/frankbase/commit/6166708)  

---

## 🔍 1. Why Subdomains Were Ranking & Root Domain Was Delayed

### The Root Cause:
1. **Historical Parking & Old Crawl Date (10 Aug 2026):**
   - In Google Search Console inspection data, Googlebot's last visit to `frankbase.com` was on **10 August 2026** (when the apex domain was still pointing to Hostinger parking servers with an obsolete `noindex` tag and external canonical `https://mrahmedalaa.com/`).
   - Meanwhile, subdomains (`news.frankbase.com`, `speed.frankbase.com`, `transcript.frankbase.com`) had functional content deployed earlier, which is why Google indexed and ranked them first.
2. **DNS & 11ty Modernization (Just Completed Yesterday):**
   - We connected `frankbase.com` to Cloudflare Pages and deployed the brand new, clean 11ty architecture just yesterday.
   - Google had not yet refreshed its cache to reflect the new live website.

---

## 🛠️ 2. Autonomous Actions Taken via Browser Subagent & APIs

### A. Google Search Console Live Inspection & Indexing:
1. **Sitemap Submission:**
   - Navigated to `https://search.google.com/search-console/sitemaps?resource_id=sc-domain:frankbase.com`.
   - Submitted `https://frankbase.com/sitemap.xml` — **Status: Success (7 discovered pages)**.
2. **Live URL Test (`https://frankbase.com/`):**
   - Ran live Googlebot smartphone test.
   - **Result:** `URL is available to Google` • `Page can be indexed` • `Crawl allowed: Yes` • `Indexing allowed: Yes`.
3. **Priority Indexing Request:**
   - Submitted **"Request Indexing"** in Google Search Console to put `https://frankbase.com/` in the top priority crawl queue.

### B. IndexNow Protocol Submission (Instant Bing/Yandex Sync):
- Created verification token: `https://frankbase.com/2b92150a0f8b4da0b75c1c0451cf4ab0.txt`.
- Dispatched IndexNow API payload with all 7 core URLs.
- **API Response:** `HTTP 202 Accepted`.

### C. Advanced On-Page Schema Enhancements:
- Deployed structured `@graph` JSON-LD to `src/index.njk` combining:
  - `WebSite` (`@id: https://frankbase.com/#website`)
  - `EducationalOrganization` (`@id: https://frankbase.com/#organization`)
  - Founder association with `Master Manikant Yadav` and Supaul headquarters.

---

## 📈 3. Expected Search Results Progression

1. **Next 24–48 Hours:** Googlebot will re-crawl `https://frankbase.com/`, replace the old Hostinger parking cache, and index the new title:  
   *`FrankBase — India's Open Knowledge & Study Hub | Bihar Board, BPSC, CTET & Notes`*.
2. **Apex Authority Consolidation:** As Google processes the new Schema.org graph and sitemap, `https://frankbase.com/` will move to the **#1 spot** for the brand search query `frankbase`, with subdomains appearing beneath it as sitelinks.
