import json
import os
import re
import shutil
from datetime import datetime

conv_id = "15a0051a-be68-4242-9b03-68cdca9e0662"
transcript_path = rf"C:\Users\IT CARE SAHARSA\.gemini\antigravity\brain\{conv_id}\.system_generated\logs\transcript_full.jsonl"

dialogues = []

with open(transcript_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for line in f:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        try:
            entry = json.loads(line)
        except Exception:
            continue
        
        step_index = entry.get("step_index", 0)
        source = entry.get("source")
        type_ = entry.get("type")
        created_at = entry.get("created_at", "")
        content = entry.get("content", "")
        
        # User input
        if type_ == "USER_INPUT" and source == "USER_EXPLICIT":
            clean_text = content
            match = re.search(r"<USER_REQUEST>(.*?)</USER_REQUEST>", content, re.DOTALL)
            if match:
                clean_text = match.group(1).strip()
            elif "<USER_REQUEST>" in content:
                clean_text = content.replace("<USER_REQUEST>", "").replace("</USER_REQUEST>", "").strip()
            
            clean_text = re.sub(r"<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>.*?</ADDITIONAL_METADATA>", "", clean_text, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
            clean_text = re.sub(r"<CONTEXT_SUMMARY>.*?</CONTEXT_SUMMARY>", "", clean_text, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
            
            if clean_text:
                dialogues.append({
                    "step": step_index,
                    "speaker": "User",
                    "timestamp": created_at,
                    "text": clean_text
                })
        
        # Model planner response
        elif source == "MODEL" and type_ == "PLANNER_RESPONSE":
            if content and content.strip():
                dialogues.append({
                    "step": step_index,
                    "speaker": "Antigravity AI",
                    "timestamp": created_at,
                    "text": content.strip()
                })

# Build Markdown content
md_lines = []
md_lines.append("# 📜 Complete Verbatim Chat Transcript & Knowledge Archive")
md_lines.append("")
md_lines.append(f"> **Conversation ID:** `{conv_id}`  ")
md_lines.append("> **Project:** FrankBase Core (`frankbase.com`) & MMY Central Command  ")
md_lines.append(f"> **Export Date & Time:** {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}  ")
md_lines.append(f"> **Total Dialogue Turns:** {len(dialogues)}  ")
md_lines.append("> **Archival Guarantee:** 100% Verbatim Chat Preservation (User Prompts & Antigravity AI Responses)  ")
md_lines.append("")
md_lines.append("---")
md_lines.append("")

turn_user = 0
turn_ai = 0

for item in dialogues:
    step = item["step"]
    speaker = item["speaker"]
    ts = item["timestamp"]
    text = item["text"]
    
    if speaker == "User":
        turn_user += 1
        md_lines.append(f"## 👤 User (सवाल / निर्देश #{turn_user})")
        md_lines.append(f"*Step #{step} | Time: {ts}*")
        md_lines.append("")
        md_lines.append(text)
        md_lines.append("")
        md_lines.append("---")
        md_lines.append("")
    else:
        turn_ai += 1
        md_lines.append(f"## 🤖 Antigravity AI (जवाब / रिपोर्ट #{turn_ai})")
        md_lines.append(f"*Step #{step} | Time: {ts}*")
        md_lines.append("")
        md_lines.append(text)
        md_lines.append("")
        md_lines.append("---")
        md_lines.append("")

md_content = "\n".join(md_lines)
json_content = json.dumps({
    "conversation_id": conv_id,
    "project": "02_frankbase.com",
    "export_timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    "total_turns": len(dialogues),
    "dialogues": dialogues
}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

# Target directories
target_dirs = [
    r"D:\01_Websites_and_Content\MMY_Website_Project\02_frankbase.com",
    r"D:\01_Websites_and_Content\MMY_Website_Project\00_MM_Central_Command\SESSION_ARCHIVES"
]

for d in target_dirs:
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    
    # Save Markdown archive
    md_path = os.path.join(d, f"COMPLETE_CHAT_ARCHIVE_{conv_id[:8]}_FRANKBASE.md")
    with open(md_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(md_content)
    print(f"Saved: {md_path}")
    
    # Save JSON archive
    json_path = os.path.join(d, f"COMPLETE_CHAT_ARCHIVE_{conv_id[:8]}_FRANKBASE.json")
    with open(json_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json_content)
    print(f"Saved: {json_path}")
    
    # Save Raw Full Transcript JSONL
    raw_path = os.path.join(d, f"FULL_RAW_TRANSCRIPT_{conv_id[:8]}_FRANKBASE.jsonl")
    shutil.copy2(transcript_path, raw_path)
    print(f"Copied Raw JSONL: {raw_path}")

print("All archives generated successfully!")
